name: trace_id
description: Unique trace identifier (ULID-style, prefixed `tr_`). Primary key.

name: project_id
description: Project the trace belongs to. Cluster column.

name: org_id
description: Org that owns the project.

name: ingest_date
description: UTC date the trace was ingested. Partition column (DAY).

name: name
description: Human-readable trace name (e.g. `checkout-agent`).

name: run_id
description: Customer-supplied run identifier.

name: run_type
description: prod | eval | dev | test | replay | backfill | other.

name: use_case
description: Customer-supplied use case label (e.g. `web-shopping`).

name: group
description: Customer-supplied group label (e.g. `nightly-2026-04-15`).

name: platform
description: web | mobile | desktop | server | robot | sim | cli | other.

name: model
description: Primary model attributed to this trace.

name: user_id
description: Customer-supplied end-user identifier.

name: status
description: success | error | running | cancelled. Cluster column.

name: error_message
description: Top-level trace error message, if status = error.

name: started_at
description: Trace start timestamp.

name: ended_at
description: Trace end timestamp.

name: latency_ms
description: ended_at - started_at in milliseconds.

name: input_tokens
description: Summed input tokens across all llm steps.

name: output_tokens
description: Summed output tokens across all llm steps.

name: total_tokens
description: Summed total tokens across all llm steps.

name: cost_usd
description: Estimated trace cost in USD.

name: tags
description: Customer-supplied tags.

name: metadata
description: Free-form trace metadata JSON.

name: step_count
description: Number of steps in the trace.

name: has_media
description: True if any step has image/audio/video/sensor/file attachments.

name: gcs_uri
description: gs:// URI of the canonical trace JSON blob.

name: schema_version
description: Version of the trace payload schema (`1.0`).
